name: hermretro-engine-build
description: Tools for building the engine bundle (engine/modretro-chromatic/dist/server.js): esbuild at the version the engine was bundled with, and the packages the bundle includes at the engine's locked versions (engine/modretro-chromatic/scripts/runtime-package-lock.json). Never needed to use the plugin. Install with: npm ci --prefix tools/engine/npm --ignore-scripts
